resolvedQuestions.question: What is Hermes's exact headless dispatch contract (flags, exit codes, machine-readable stdout, session id) and how does it compare with the six runtimes?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Three shapes: hermes -z (answer-only stdout, no session id), chat -q on non-TTY (oneshot implied), chat -Q (quiet; response to stdout, session_id: to stderr, Error: to stderr). Exit codes: -z 0/1/2 (success/failure/usage), chat -Q 0/1/130. --query-file is injection-safe. No JSON output format on chat -Q; session id via --usage-file in -z. Distinct vs six runtimes: session-id-on-stderr, exit 2 usage errors, native --worktree.

resolvedQuestions.question: Which providers/models can Hermes reach with the credential kinds already on this machine, and what is a fail-closed HERMES_SUPPORTED_MODELS roster?
What does Hermes read from the working directory, how does skills trust/quarantine treat a symlinked skill tree, and what must live at the repo root versus ~/.hermes?
How far is this repo's SKILL.md format from Hermes's requirements, which hubs would load or be quarantined, and is there a non-installing report command?
How can the repo's 13 agents and nested commands be reached from Hermes (profiles, delegate_task, skills, inlined persona, slash commands)?
Which hook events/payloads/consent semantics does Hermes have, and can the repo's guard cores be bridged as hooks, plugins, or Agent Plugins v1?
How are MCP servers configured, can the repo's native servers and code-mode manual connect over stdio, and what is the deny-by-default enforcement point?
Is Hermes fit as a deep-loop fan-out executor (write flags, yolo/approval, timeout, state isolation, self-invocation detection, trustworthy exit codes, containment)?
Where does Hermes cost more or less than the six runtimes (runtime, latency, background subsystems, memory injection, approvals, telemetry), and which hard rules must the skill packet carry?
What phase plan should phases 002+ follow, which candidate phases merge/split/drop, and what stays UNKNOWN until a live contract pin?

keyFindings.title: Three headless shapes: -z oneshot, chat -q non-TTY oneshot, chat -Q quiet
keyFindings.summary: hermes -z prints only final response text (no session id line); chat -q on non-TTY implies --oneshot; chat -Q suppresses banner/spinner and prints response + session info

keyFindings.title: --query-file is injection-safe
keyFindings.summary: Reads query from file or stdin (-), nothing shell-interpreted, mutually exclusive with -q

keyFindings.title: -Q stdout machine-readable, session id on stderr
keyFindings.summary: Response to stdout; session_id: line to stderr; backend errors as Error: on stderr

keyFindings.title: Exit codes: -z 0/1/2; chat -Q 0/1/130
keyFindings.summary: -z: 0 success, 1 agent failure/no response, 2 usage error or failed/partial with empty response; chat -Q: 0 success, 1 failed, 130 interrupt

keyFindings.title: Isolation flags: --ignore-user-config/--ignore-rules/--safe-mode

keyFindings.label: Profiles are state islands, not personas

keyFindings.label: Persona routes: inline prompt or persona-skill

keyFindings.label: Self-invocation: HERMES_TURN_AUTHOR marker, scrubbed from children
keyFindings.summary: Dispatcher sets it on recipient one-shot; Hermes consumes+removes so children do not inherit; nested hermes NOT blocked natively; cli-hermes not SELF_PRESENCE_EXEMPT; ancestry layer required

keyFindings.label: Exit codes trustworthy; ~/.hermes writes outside containment

keyFindings.label: Startup 0.86s measured; version drift real

keyFindings.label: Background subsystems off by default
keyFindings.summary: No curator/gateway/cron config; curator auxiliary-defaulted, never a gate; assumption background-subsystems-assumed-off

keyFindings.label: hermes pause does NOT stop CLI dispatches
keyFindings.summary: estop scopes to cron/kanban/new gateway turns; in-flight never killed; runner kill is the fan-out emergency stop

keyFindings.label: Terminal backends offer optional extra containment
keyFindings.summary: local/docker/ssh/modal/daytona/singularity with local_env_policy; hardening option, not phase-1 requirement

keyFindings.label: SOUL.md + memory injection are isolation costs

keyFindings.label: Full comparison table produced (14 capabilities x 7 runtimes)
